features.title: Edit a file the Agent inspected without the native read tool
features.summary: The apply_patch agent tool reads the file itself, records that read on the Host's observation policy, applies literal replacements in order with a whitespace-tolerant fallback, and writes once; it never creates a file.
failureModes: An ambiguous or missing anchor fails before writing and names the candidate lines.
An empty or unchanged needle is rejected before the file is touched.
Without a working directory, or for a file that does not exist, the tool refuses instead of creating one.
Read-only Sessions and workspace-write escapes retain FS_SANDBOX_DENIED; the Session policy is resolved per call instead of falling back to the deployment policy.
A confining filesystem without the shared policy resolver refuses before any write.

verification.testName: replaces one literal match and reports it as exact
refuses an ambiguous literal match and names the lines
finds a reindented block after the literal match fails
fails with missing when no literal or whitespace match exists
applies edits in order so a later anchor sees the earlier result
honors Full access despite a workspace-write deployment default
retains read-only denial even when the deployment default is Full access
rejects outside and symlink-escape writes under workspace-write

verification.reason: apply_patch is an agent tool with no browser UI of its own; its edit semantics are covered by tests/apply-edits.test.ts and the Host bundle is import-checked after each build.
